top_signals.title: Gold Gains as Soft US Jobs Report Eases Bets on Fed Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Gold rose as a sharp slowdown in the US jobs market reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged in October.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Japan’s JERA Creates Oil Storage Firm to Manage National Reserve Sites
top_signals.summary: Japanese energy firm JERA is creating an oil storage company which will exclusively manage the operation of the national petroleum stockpiling bases that JERA currently operates, as the Middle East crisis has upended the oil procurement market in the resource-poor G7 economy of Japan. JERA Co., Inc. said on Friday it had established JERA Oil Storage as a dedicated operating company to manage the operation of national petroleum stockpiling bases currently operated by JERA and its affiliated subsidiaries under a joint contracting arrangement with…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
